description: Configuration panel assets before the signalk-nearlcrews-ui migration
approval: Recalibrated for the signalk-nearlcrews-ui 0.8.1 upgrade, which measures 34240 gzip bytes. The 0.8.1 additions are the deferred-clearance pointer handling and the bounded docking measurement that fix the viewport-bottom action bar, plus the segmented-control form-reset fix, together worth 260 bytes over 0.8.0's measured 33980. The ceiling moves from 35000 to 36000 because 34240 left only 2 percent of headroom, where the rest of the plugin family runs 5 to 10 percent, so an ordinary panel edit would have failed the gate rather than a real regression. The 0.8.0 growth was runtime popover-trigger and labelable-control validation, the panel-contained toast viewport host, and viewport-bottom action-bar focus preservation; the prior 33000-byte ceiling covered the 0.7.0 migration.
